H2320: the new moon; by implication, a month

H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),

H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)

H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)

H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H4940: a family, i.e. circle of relatives; figuratively, a class (of persons), a species (of animals) or sort (of things); by extension a tribe or people
H8432: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
H2143: a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration
H1323: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
H32: Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses

H8145: properly, double, i.e. second; also adverbially, again
H7651: seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number
H7965: safe, i.e. (figuratively) well, happy, friendly; also (abstractly) welfare, i.e. health, prosperity, peace
